title: Import products from CSV
subtitle: Creates new inactive or active products in one step. Existing products are never changed.
formatDescription: UTF-8 CSV with a header row. sku and name are required; the other columns are optional and can be in any order:
formatNotes: unitId, categoryId and tagIds use IDs of your units, categories and tags; copy them on the Categories, tags & units page (tagIds as a JSON list, e.g. ["…"]). basePrice is a net price like 12.50. activate is true or false; with stock tracking on, imported products can't be activated. Up to 1,000 rows and 5 MB; 3 checks per hour.
tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
summary: {count, plural, one {{countText} row} other {{countText} rows}} · valid until {time}
invalid: Fix the errors below in your file, then check it again.
name: Name
done: {count, plural, one {{countText} product added} other {{countText} products added}}
doneDescription: Imported products are in your catalogue. Add images and stock counts there.
staleTitle: Some rows are no longer valid
staleDescription: The catalogue changed since the check (for example a SKU was taken). Nothing was imported. Fix the file and check it again.

code.STOCK_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Can't activate while stock tracking is on
